      background: var(--blue-500);
      border-radius: 6px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .logo-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    .nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }

    .nav-item {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--slate-700);

      color: var(--navy-900);
      background: var(--slate-100);
    }

      height: 14px;
      transition: transform var(--transition-fast);
    }

    /* ===== MEGA MENU ===== */
    .mega-menu {
      position: absolute;
      top: 100%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      min-width: 640px;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);

      visibility: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity var(--transition-base), visibility var(--transition-base);

    }

    .mega-menu.is-open {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .mega-menu-grid {

      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);

    .mega-menu-col h4 {

    .mega-menu-link {

      color: var(--navy-900);

    .mega-menu-link-desc {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-top: 2px;

    /* ===== HERO ===== */
    .hero {
      padding: 64px 0 0;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-size: 48px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy-900);
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .hero p {
      margin-top: 16px;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      max-width: 560px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ===== CATEGORY FILTERS ===== */
    .filters-section {
      padding: 40px 0 0;
      position: relative;
    }

    .filters-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .category-pills {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .pill {
      padding: 7px 16px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--slate-600);
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: 999px;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .pill:hover {
      color: var(--navy-900);
      border-color: var(--slate-300);
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .pill:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--blue-500);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .pill.is-active {
      color: var(--white);
      background: var(--navy-900);
      border-color: var(--navy-900);
    }

    .search-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .search-wrapper svg {
      position: absolute;
      left: 12px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      color: var(--slate-400);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .search-input {
      padding: 8px 14px 8px 36px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-family: inherit;
      color: var(--slate-800);
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: 999px;
      outline: none;
      width: 200px;
      transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast), width var(--transition-slow);
    }

    .search-input::placeholder { color: var(--slate-400); }

    .search-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--blue-500);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,114,245,0.15);
      width: 260px;
    }

    /* ===== FEATURED ARTICLES ===== */
    .featured-section {
      padding: 48px 0 0;
    }

    .featured-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      grid-template-rows: auto auto;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .featured-card {
      position: relative;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 32px;
      transition: border-color var(--transition-base), box-shadow var(--transition-base);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .featured-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--slate-300);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .featured-card:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--blue-500);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .featured-card--main {
      grid-column: 1 / 2;
      grid-row: 1 / 3;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a1628 0%, #0f2440 100%);
      border-color: transparent;
      color: var(--white);
      min-height: 440px;
    }

    .featured-card--main:hover {
      box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(10,22,40,0.3);
    }

    .featured-card--main .featured-tag { background: rgba(0,114,245,0.2); color: #60a5fa; }
    .featured-card--main .featured-date { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); }
    .featured-card--main .featured-title { color: var(--white); }
    .featured-card--main .featured-excerpt { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
    .featured-card--main .featured-author-name { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }

    .featured-card--side {
      min-height: 210px;
    }

    .featured-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      background: var(--blue-50);
      color: var(--blue-500);
      border-radius: 999px;
      width: fit-content;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .featured-date {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .featured-title {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.3;
      color: var(--navy-900);
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .featured-card--main .featured-title {
      font-size: 28px;
    }

    .featured-excerpt {
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.65;
      color: var(--slate-600);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .featured-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: auto;
    }

    .featured-avatar {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .featured-card--main .featured-avatar { background: rgba(0,114,245,0.3); color: #93bbfd; }
    .featured-card--side .featured-avatar { background: var(--blue-50); color: var(--blue-500); }

    .featured-author-name {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--slate-700);
    }

    /* ===== AGENTIC STATS ===== */
    .stats-bar {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 32px 0;
    }

    .stat-item {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 20px;
      text-align: center;
      transition: border-color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .stat-item:hover { border-color: var(--slate-300); }

    .stat-value {
      font-size: 28px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--blue-500);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      margin-top: 6px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    /* ===== LATEST NEWS ===== */
    .latest-section {
      padding: 32px 0;
    }

    .section-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy-900);
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }

    .news-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .news-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      transition: border-color var(--transition-base), box-shadow var(--transition-base);
    }

    .news-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--slate-300);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .news-card:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--blue-500);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .news-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 3px 10px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      color: var(--slate-600);
      border-radius: 999px;
      width: fit-content;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .news-tag--engineering { background: #FEF3C7; color: #92400E; }
    .news-tag--community { background: #DBEAFE; color: #1E40AF; }
    .news-tag--customers { background: #D1FAE5; color: #065F46; }
    .news-tag--security { background: #FEE2E2; color: #991B1B; }
    .news-tag--company-news { background: #EDE9FE; color: #5B21B6; }
    .news-tag--v0 { background: #FCE7F3; color: #9D174D; }
    .news-tag--changelog { background: #F3F4F6; color: #374151; }
    .news-tag--press { background: #F0FDFA; color: #134E4A; }

    .news-date {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--slate-400);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .news-title {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy-900);
      line-height: 1.35;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      letter-spacing: -0.005em;
    }

    .news-excerpt {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      flex: 1;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .news-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: auto;
    }

    .news-avatar {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: var(--blue-50);
      color: var(--blue-500);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .news-author-name {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Show more button */
    .show-more-wrapper {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 40px 0 24px;
    }

    .btn-show-more {
      padding: 12px 32px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--navy-900);
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-300);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-show-more:hover {
      border-color: var(--slate-400);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .btn-show-more:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--blue-500);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .btn-show-more:disabled {
      color: var(--slate-400);
      border-color: var(--slate-200);
      cursor: default;
    }

    /* No results */
    .no-results {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 64px 24px;
      display: none;
    }

    .no-results.visible { display: block; }

    .no-results svg {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      color: var(--slate-300);
      margin: 0 auto 16px;
    }

    .no-results h3 {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--slate-700);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .no-results p {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--slate-400);
      max-width: 360px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* ===== CTA BANNER ===== */
    .cta-section {
      padding: 64px 0;
    }

    .cta-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .cta-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 48px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .cta-card--primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a1628 0%, #0f2440 100%);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .cta-card--secondary {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
    }

    .cta-headline {
      font-size: 26px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.3;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .cta-card--primary .cta-headline { color: var(--white); }
    .cta-card--secondary .cta-headline { color: var(--navy-900); }

    .cta-text {
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .cta-card--primary .cta-text { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
    .cta-card--secondary .cta-text { color: var(--slate-500); }

    .cta-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      padding: 11px 24px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: var(--blue-500);
      color: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: background var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-600); }

    .btn-primary:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--blue-500);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      padding: 11px 24px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      color: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }

    .btn-outline {
      padding: 11px 24px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--navy-900);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-300);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-outline:hover {
      border-color: var(--slate-400);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .cta-card--primary .pro { color: var(--orange-500); font-weight: 700; }
    .cta-card--primary .enterprise { color: #60a5fa; font-weight: 700; }

    /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
    .footer {
      background: var(--navy-900);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      padding: 64px 0 32px;
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .footer-col h5 {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .footer-col ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }

    .footer-col a {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .footer-col a:hover { color: var(--white); }

    .footer-bottom {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding-top: 24px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }

    .footer-status {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .status-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      background: #22c55e;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    /* ===== MOBILE NAV ===== */
    .mobile-menu-btn {
      display: none;
      padding: 8px;
      color: var(--slate-700);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }

    .mobile-menu-btn svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

    /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
      .stats-bar { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav { display: none; }
      .header-actions .btn-ask-ai,
      .header-actions .btn-login { display: none; }
      .mobile-menu-btn { display: flex; }

      .hero h1 { font-size: 32px; }
      .hero p { font-size: 16px; }

      .featured-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .featured-card--main {
        grid-column: auto;
        grid-row: auto;
        min-height: 320px;
      }

      .featured-card--main .featured-title { font-size: 22px; }

      .news-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

      .cta-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .cta-card { padding: 32px; }

      .stats-bar { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

      .mega-menu { min-width: auto; left: 0; right: 0; transform: none; }
      .mega-menu-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 16px; }
      .resources-menu { min-width: auto; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .container { padding: 0 16px; }
      .hero h1 { font-size: 28px; }

      .news-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

      .stats-bar { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

      .filters-bar { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
      .category-pills { justify-content: flex-start; overflow-x: auto; flex-wrap: nowrap; padding-bottom: 4px; }
      .search-input { width: 100%; }
      .search-input:focus { width: 100%; }

      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .cta-card { padding: 24px; }
    }

    /* ===== REDUCED MOTION ===== */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after {
        animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      }
    }

    /* Mobile slide-out menu */
    .mobile-nav-overlay {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      z-index: 9000;
    }

    .mobile-nav-overlay.is-open { display: block; }

    .mobile-nav-drawer {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      right: 0;
      width: 280px;
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--white);
      z-index: 9001;
      transform: translateX(100%);
      transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 24px;
    }

    .mobile-nav-drawer.is-open { transform: translateX(0); }

    .mobile-nav-drawer .mobile-nav-close {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .mobile-nav-drawer .mobile-nav-close button {
      padding: 8px;
      color: var(--slate-600);
    }

    .mobile-nav-drawer ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }

    .mobile-nav-drawer a, .mobile-nav-drawer button {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--slate-700);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: background var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .mobile-nav-drawer a:hover, .mobile-nav-drawer button:hover {
      background: var(--slate-100);
    }

    .mobile-nav-drawer .mobile-divider {
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--slate-200);
      margin: 12px 0;
    }
  </style>
</head>

    function getFilteredPosts() {
      return allPosts.filter(post => {
        const matchCategory = currentCategory === 'all' || post.category === currentCategory;
        const matchSearch = searchQuery === '' ||
          post.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
          post.excerpt.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
          post.author.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
        return matchCategory && matchSearch;
      });
    }

    function renderGrid() {
      const grid = document.getElementById('news-grid');
      const noResults = document.getElementById('no-results');
      const showMoreWrapper = document.getElementById('show-more-wrapper');

      const filtered = getFilteredPosts();
      const visible = filtered.slice(0, visibleCount);

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        grid.innerHTML = '';
        noResults.classList.add('visible');
        showMoreWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      noResults.classList.remove('visible');
      grid.innerHTML = visible.map(createCardHTML).join('');
      showMoreWrapper.style.display = visibleCount >= filtered.length ? 'none' : 'block';
    }

    // ===== CATEGORY FILTER =====
    function filterByCategory(category, btn) {
      currentCategory = category;
      visibleCount = INITIAL_COUNT;

      // Update pills
      document.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(p => {
        p.classList.remove('is-active');
        p.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
      });
      btn.classList.add('is-active');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');

      renderGrid();
    }

    // ===== SEARCH =====
    let searchTimeout;
    function handleSearch(value) {
      clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
      searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        searchQuery = value.trim();
        visibleCount = INITIAL_COUNT;
        renderGrid();
      }, 200);
    }

    // ===== SHOW MORE =====
    function showMorePosts() {
      visibleCount += 6;
      renderGrid();
    }

    // ===== MEGA MENU =====
    function toggleMegaMenu(menu) {
      const menuEl = document.getElementById(menu + '-menu');
      const btnEl = document.getElementById(menu + '-btn');
      const isOpen = menuEl.classList.contains('is-open');

      // Close all menus first
      document.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('is-open'));
      document.querySelectorAll('[aria-expanded]').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));

      if (!isOpen) {
        menuEl.classList.add('is-open');
        btnEl.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }
    }

    // Close mega menus on outside click
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('.nav-item[style]') && !e.target.closest('.mega-menu')) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('is-open'));
        document.querySelectorAll('[aria-expanded]').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));
      }
    });

    // Close mega menus on Escape
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        document.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('is-open'));
        document.querySelectorAll('[aria-expanded]').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));
      }
    });

    // ===== MOBILE NAV =====
    function toggleMobileNav() {
      const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-overlay');
      const drawer = document.getElementById('mobile-drawer');
      const isOpen = drawer.classList.contains('is-open');

      if (isOpen) {
        drawer.classList.remove('is-open');
        overlay.classList.remove('is-open');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      } else {
        drawer.classList.add('is-open');
        overlay.classList.add('is-open');
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      }
    }

    // ===== INIT =====
    renderGrid();
  </script>

      grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .cta-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 48px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .cta-card--primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a1628 0%, #0f2440 100%);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .cta-card--secondary {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
    }

    .cta-headline {
      font-size: 26px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.3;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .cta-card--primary .cta-headline { color: var(--white); }
    .cta-card--secondary .cta-headline { color: var(--navy-900); }

    .cta-text {
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .cta-card--primary .cta-text { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
    .cta-card--secondary .cta-text { color: var(--slate-500); }

    .cta-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      padding: 11px 24px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: var(--blue-500);
      color: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: background var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-600); }

    .btn-primary:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--blue-500);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      padding: 11px 24px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      color: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }

    .btn-outline {
      padding: 11px 24px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--navy-900);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-300);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-outline:hover {
      border-color: var(--slate-400);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .cta-card--primary .pro { color: var(--orange-500); font-weight: 700; }
    .cta-card--primary .enterprise { color: #60a5fa; font-weight: 700; }

    /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
    .footer {
      background: var(--navy-900);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      padding: 64px 0 32px;
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .footer-col h5 {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .footer-col ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }

    .footer-col a {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .footer-col a:hover { color: var(--white); }

    .footer-bottom {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding-top: 24px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }

    .footer-status {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .status-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      background: #22c55e;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    /* ===== MOBILE NAV ===== */
    .mobile-menu-btn {
      display: none;
      padding: 8px;
      color: var(--slate-700);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }

    .mobile-menu-btn svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

    /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
      .stats-bar { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav { display: none; }
      .header-actions .btn-ask-ai,
      .header-actions .btn-login { display: none; }
      .mobile-menu-btn { display: flex; }

      .hero h1 { font-size: 32px; }
      .hero p { font-size: 16px; }

      .featured-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .featured-card--main {
        grid-column: auto;
        grid-row: auto;
        min-height: 320px;
      }

      .featured-card--main .featured-title { font-size: 22px; }

      .news-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

      .cta-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .cta-card { padding: 32px; }

      .stats-bar { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

      .mega-menu { min-width: auto; left: 0; right: 0; transform: none; }
      .mega-menu-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 16px; }
      .resources-menu { min-width: auto; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .container { padding: 0 16px; }
      .hero h1 { font-size: 28px; }

      .news-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

      .stats-bar { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

      .filters-bar { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
      .category-pills { justify-content: flex-start; overflow-x: auto; flex-wrap: nowrap; padding-bottom: 4px; }
      .search-input { width: 100%; }
      .search-input:focus { width: 100%; }

      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .cta-card { padding: 24px; }
    }

    /* ===== REDUCED MOTION ===== */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after {
        animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      }
    }

    /* Mobile slide-out menu */
    .mobile-nav-overlay {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      z-index: 9000;
    }

    .mobile-nav-overlay.is-open { display: block; }

    .mobile-nav-drawer {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      right: 0;
      width: 280px;
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--white);
      z-index: 9001;
      transform: translateX(100%);
      transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 24px;
    }

    .mobile-nav-drawer.is-open { transform: translateX(0); }

    .mobile-nav-drawer .mobile-nav-close {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .mobile-nav-drawer .mobile-nav-close button {
      padding: 8px;
      color: var(--slate-600);
    }

    .mobile-nav-drawer ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }

    .mobile-nav-drawer a, .mobile-nav-drawer button {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--slate-700);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);

    }

    .mobile-nav-drawer a:hover, .mobile-nav-drawer button:hover {
      background: var(--slate-100);
    }

    .mobile-nav-drawer .mobile-divider {
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--slate-200);
      margin: 12px 0;
    }
  </style>
</head>

    function getCategoryClass(cat) {
      const map = {
        'engineering': 'news-tag--engineering',

        'security': 'news-tag--security',
        'company-news': 'news-tag--company-news',
        'v0': 'news-tag--v0',
        'changelog': 'news-tag--changelog',
        'press': 'news-tag--press',
      };
      return map[cat] || '';
    }

    function formatCategoryLabel(cat) {
      const map = {
        'general': 'General',
        'engineering': 'Engineering',
        'community': 'Community',
        'customers': 'Customers',
        'security': 'Security',
        'company-news': 'Company News',
        'v0': 'v0',
        'changelog': 'Changelog',
        'press': 'Press',
      };
      return map[cat] || cat;
    }

    // ===== RENDER CARDS =====
    function createCardHTML(post) {
      return `
        <a href="#" class="news-card" tabindex="0">
          <span class="news-tag ${getCategoryClass(post.category)}">${formatCategoryLabel(post.category)}</span>
          <span class="news-date">${post.date}</span>
          <span class="news-title">${post.title}</span>
          <span class="news-excerpt">${post.excerpt}</span>
          <span class="news-author">
            <span class="news-avatar">${post.initials}</span>
            <span class="news-author-name">${post.author}</span>
          </span>
        </a>
      `;
    }

    function getFilteredPosts() {
      return allPosts.filter(post => {
        const matchCategory = currentCategory === 'all' || post.category === currentCategory;
        const matchSearch = searchQuery === '' ||
          post.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
          post.excerpt.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
          post.author.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
        return matchCategory && matchSearch;
      });
    }

    function renderGrid() {
      const grid = document.getElementById('news-grid');
      const noResults = document.getElementById('no-results');
      const showMoreWrapper = document.getElementById('show-more-wrapper');

      const filtered = getFilteredPosts();
      const visible = filtered.slice(0, visibleCount);

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        grid.innerHTML = '';
        noResults.classList.add('visible');
        showMoreWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      noResults.classList.remove('visible');
      grid.innerHTML = visible.map(createCardHTML).join('');
      showMoreWrapper.style.display = visibleCount >= filtered.length ? 'none' : 'block';
    }

    // ===== CATEGORY FILTER =====
    function filterByCategory(category, btn) {
      currentCategory = category;
      visibleCount = INITIAL_COUNT;

      // Update pills
      document.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(p => {
        p.classList.remove('is-active');
        p.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
      });
      btn.classList.add('is-active');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');

      renderGrid();
    }

    // ===== SEARCH =====
    let searchTimeout;
    function handleSearch(value) {
      clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
      searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        searchQuery = value.trim();
        visibleCount = INITIAL_COUNT;
        renderGrid();
      }, 200);
    }

    // ===== SHOW MORE =====
    function showMorePosts() {
      visibleCount += 6;
      renderGrid();
    }

    // ===== MEGA MENU =====
    function toggleMegaMenu(menu) {
      const menuEl = document.getElementById(menu + '-menu');
      const btnEl = document.getElementById(menu + '-btn');
      const isOpen = menuEl.classList.contains('is-open');

      // Close all menus first
      document.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('is-open'));
      document.querySelectorAll('[aria-expanded]').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));

      if (!isOpen) {
        menuEl.classList.add('is-open');
        btnEl.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }
    }

    // Close mega menus on outside click
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('.nav-item[style]') && !e.target.closest('.mega-menu')) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('is-open'));
        document.querySelectorAll('[aria-expanded]').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));
      }
    });

    // Close mega menus on Escape
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        document.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('is-open'));
        document.querySelectorAll('[aria-expanded]').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));
      }
    });

    // ===== MOBILE NAV =====
    function toggleMobileNav() {
      const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-overlay');
      const drawer = document.getElementById('mobile-drawer');
      const isOpen = drawer.classList.contains('is-open');

      if (isOpen) {
        drawer.classList.remove('is-open');
        overlay.classList.remove('is-open');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      } else {
        drawer.classList.add('is-open');
        overlay.classList.add('is-open');
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      }
    }

    // ===== INIT =====
    renderGrid();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      white-space: nowrap;

    .pill:hover {
      color: var(--navy-900);
      border-color: var(--slate-300);
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .pill:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--blue-500);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .pill.is-active {
      color: var(--white);
      background: var(--navy-900);
      border-color: var(--navy-900);
    }

    .search-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .search-wrapper svg {
      position: absolute;
      left: 12px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      color: var(--slate-400);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .search-input {
      padding: 8px 14px 8px 36px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-family: inherit;
      color: var(--slate-800);
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);

      outline: none;

      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,114,245,0.15);

    /* ===== FEATURED ARTICLES ===== */
    .featured-section {

    }

    .featured-grid {

      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      grid-template-rows: auto auto;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .featured-card {
      position: relative;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 32px;
      transition: border-color var(--transition-base), box-shadow var(--transition-base);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      overflow: hidden;

    .featured-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--slate-300);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .featured-card:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--blue-500);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .featured-card--main {
      grid-column: 1 / 2;
      grid-row: 1 / 3;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a1628 0%, #0f2440 100%);
      border-color: transparent;
      color: var(--white);
      min-height: 440px;
    }

    .featured-card--main:hover {
      box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(10,22,40,0.3);
    }

    .featured-card--main .featured-tag { background: rgba(0,114,245,0.2); color: #60a5fa; }
    .featured-card--main .featured-date { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); }
    .featured-card--main .featured-title { color: var(--white); }
    .featured-card--main .featured-excerpt { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
    .featured-card--main .featured-author-name { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }

    .featured-card--side {
      min-height: 210px;
    }

    .featured-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      background: var(--blue-50);
      color: var(--blue-500);
      border-radius: 999px;
      width: fit-content;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .featured-date {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .featured-title {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.3;
      color: var(--navy-900);
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .featured-card--main .featured-title {
      font-size: 28px;
    }

    .featured-excerpt {
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.65;
      color: var(--slate-600);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .featured-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: auto;
    }

    .featured-avatar {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .featured-card--main .featured-avatar { background: rgba(0,114,245,0.3); color: #93bbfd; }
    .featured-card--side .featured-avatar { background: var(--blue-50); color: var(--blue-500); }

    .featured-author-name {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--slate-700);
    }

    /* ===== AGENTIC STATS ===== */
    .stats-bar {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 32px 0;
    }

    .stat-item {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 20px;
      text-align: center;
      transition: border-color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .stat-item:hover { border-color: var(--slate-300); }

    .stat-value {
      font-size: 28px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--blue-500);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      margin-top: 6px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    /* ===== LATEST NEWS ===== */
    .latest-section {
      padding: 32px 0;
    }

    .section-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy-900);
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }

    .news-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .news-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      transition: border-color var(--transition-base), box-shadow var(--transition-base);
    }

    .news-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--slate-300);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .news-card:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--blue-500);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .news-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 3px 10px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      color: var(--slate-600);
      border-radius: 999px;
      width: fit-content;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .news-tag--engineering { background: #FEF3C7; color: #92400E; }
    .news-tag--community { background: #DBEAFE; color: #1E40AF; }
    .news-tag--customers { background: #D1FAE5; color: #065F46; }
    .news-tag--security { background: #FEE2E2; color: #991B1B; }
    .news-tag--company-news { background: #EDE9FE; color: #5B21B6; }
    .news-tag--v0 { background: #FCE7F3; color: #9D174D; }
    .news-tag--changelog { background: #F3F4F6; color: #374151; }
    .news-tag--press { background: #F0FDFA; color: #134E4A; }

    .news-date {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--slate-400);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .news-title {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy-900);
      line-height: 1.35;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      letter-spacing: -0.005em;
    }

    .news-excerpt {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      flex: 1;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .news-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: auto;
    }

    .news-avatar {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: var(--blue-50);
      color: var(--blue-500);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .news-author-name {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Show more button */
    .show-more-wrapper {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 40px 0 24px;
    }

    .btn-show-more {
      padding: 12px 32px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--navy-900);
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-300);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-show-more:hover {
      border-color: var(--slate-400);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .btn-show-more:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--blue-500);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .btn-show-more:disabled {
      color: var(--slate-400);
      border-color: var(--slate-200);
      cursor: default;
    }

    /* No results */
    .no-results {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 64px 24px;
      display: none;
    }

    .no-results.visible { display: block; }

    .no-results svg {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      color: var(--slate-300);
      margin: 0 auto 16px;
    }

    .no-results h3 {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--slate-700);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .no-results p {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--slate-400);
      max-width: 360px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* ===== CTA BANNER ===== */
    .cta-section {
      padding: 64px 0;
    }

    .cta-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .cta-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 48px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .cta-card--primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a1628 0%, #0f2440 100%);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .cta-card--secondary {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
    }

    .cta-headline {
      font-size: 26px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.3;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .cta-card--primary .cta-headline { color: var(--white); }
    .cta-card--secondary .cta-headline { color: var(--navy-900); }

    .cta-text {
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .cta-card--primary .cta-text { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
    .cta-card--secondary .cta-text { color: var(--slate-500); }

    .cta-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      padding: 11px 24px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: var(--blue-500);
      color: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: background var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-600); }

    .btn-primary:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--blue-500);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      padding: 11px 24px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      color: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }

    .btn-outline {
      padding: 11px 24px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--navy-900);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-300);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-outline:hover {
      border-color: var(--slate-400);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .cta-card--primary .pro { color: var(--orange-500); font-weight: 700; }
    .cta-card--primary .enterprise { color: #60a5fa; font-weight: 700; }

    /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
    .footer {
      background: var(--navy-900);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      padding: 64px 0 32px;
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .footer-col h5 {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      margin-bottom: 16px;

    .footer-col ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }

    .footer-col a {

      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);

      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);

    .footer-status {

      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;

    .status-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      background: #22c55e;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    /* ===== MOBILE NAV ===== */
    .mobile-menu-btn {
      display: none;
      padding: 8px;
      color: var(--slate-700);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }

    .mobile-menu-btn svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

    /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
      .stats-bar { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav { display: none; }
      .header-actions .btn-ask-ai,
      .header-actions .btn-login { display: none; }
      .mobile-menu-btn { display: flex; }

      .hero h1 { font-size: 32px; }
      .hero p { font-size: 16px; }

      .featured-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .featured-card--main {
        grid-column: auto;
        grid-row: auto;
        min-height: 320px;
      }

      .featured-card--main .featured-title { font-size: 22px; }

      .news-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

      .cta-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .cta-card { padding: 32px; }

      .stats-bar { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

      .mega-menu { min-width: auto; left: 0; right: 0; transform: none; }
      .mega-menu-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 16px; }
      .resources-menu { min-width: auto; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .container { padding: 0 16px; }
      .hero h1 { font-size: 28px; }

      .news-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

      .stats-bar { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

      .filters-bar { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
      .category-pills { justify-content: flex-start; overflow-x: auto; flex-wrap: nowrap; padding-bottom: 4px; }
      .search-input { width: 100%; }
      .search-input:focus { width: 100%; }

      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .cta-card { padding: 24px; }
    }

    /* ===== REDUCED MOTION ===== */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after {
        animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      }
    }

    /* Mobile slide-out menu */
    .mobile-nav-overlay {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      z-index: 9000;
    }

    .mobile-nav-overlay.is-open { display: block; }

    .mobile-nav-drawer {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      right: 0;
      width: 280px;
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--white);
      z-index: 9001;
      transform: translateX(100%);
      transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 24px;
    }

    .mobile-nav-drawer.is-open { transform: translateX(0); }

    .mobile-nav-drawer .mobile-nav-close {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .mobile-nav-drawer .mobile-nav-close button {
      padding: 8px;
      color: var(--slate-600);
    }

    .mobile-nav-drawer ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }

    .mobile-nav-drawer a, .mobile-nav-drawer button {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--slate-700);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: background var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .mobile-nav-drawer a:hover, .mobile-nav-drawer button:hover {
      background: var(--slate-100);
    }

    .mobile-nav-drawer .mobile-divider {
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--slate-200);
      margin: 12px 0;
    }
  </style>
</head>

          post.author.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
        return matchCategory && matchSearch;
      });
    }

      const noResults = document.getElementById('no-results');
      const showMoreWrapper = document.getElementById('show-more-wrapper');

      const filtered = getFilteredPosts();
      const visible = filtered.slice(0, visibleCount);

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        grid.innerHTML = '';
        noResults.classList.add('visible');
        showMoreWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      noResults.classList.remove('visible');
      grid.innerHTML = visible.map(createCardHTML).join('');
      showMoreWrapper.style.display = visibleCount >= filtered.length ? 'none' : 'block';

        searchQuery = value.trim();
        visibleCount = INITIAL_COUNT;
        renderGrid();
      }, 200);
    }

    // ===== SHOW MORE =====
    function showMorePosts() {
      visibleCount += 6;
      renderGrid();
    }

    // ===== MEGA MENU =====
    function toggleMegaMenu(menu) {
      const menuEl = document.getElementById(menu + '-menu');
      const btnEl = document.getElementById(menu + '-btn');
      const isOpen = menuEl.classList.contains('is-open');

      // Close all menus first
      document.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('is-open'));
      document.querySelectorAll('[aria-expanded]').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));

      if (!isOpen) {
        menuEl.classList.add('is-open');
        btnEl.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }
    }

    // Close mega menus on outside click
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('.nav-item[style]') && !e.target.closest('.mega-menu')) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('is-open'));
        document.querySelectorAll('[aria-expanded]').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));
      }
    });

    // Close mega menus on Escape
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        document.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('is-open'));
        document.querySelectorAll('[aria-expanded]').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));
      }
    });

    // ===== MOBILE NAV =====
    function toggleMobileNav() {
      const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-overlay');
      const drawer = document.getElementById('mobile-drawer');
      const isOpen = drawer.classList.contains('is-open');

      if (isOpen) {
        drawer.classList.remove('is-open');
        overlay.classList.remove('is-open');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      } else {
        drawer.classList.add('is-open');
        overlay.classList.add('is-open');
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      }
    }

    // ===== INIT =====
    renderGrid();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
